name: Aeon Nexus (3-4)

stealth.details: (DC 20 to find the cluster of aeon stones at the center of the nexus in the fog)

disable: DC 23 Thievery check (trained) to remove one nexus aeon stone from the center
routine: (3 actions) The trap loses one action each turn for each nexus aeon stone removed from its center. On each action, it shoots a jet of electrified, razor-sharp aeon stone shards at a different creature within 30 feet, dealing 1d8 piercing damage and 1d8 electricity damage (DC 21 basic Reflex save).

items.name: Static
items.text:
Trigger A creature who is not carrying a wayfinder with an aeon stone from the nexus slotted into it approaches within 15 feet of the aeon nexus

---

Effect The trap shocks the target, dealing 2d8 electricity damage to the triggering creature (DC 21 basic Reflex save), then rolls initiative.

text: A small cluster of aeon stones floats two feet off the ground, orbiting by shards of shattered aeon stones that crackle with electricity.
